baseline_contract: Preserve exact current ImageCustody.pm, plan, harness, auditor, baseline results, immediate allocation ledger and TAP before repair. Capacity is expected to reject while its actual aliased directory remains open; injected EIO before/within names is expected to be misreported as incomplete membership; EIO after all three actual expected names is expected to be ignored with successful helper completion. Baseline qualified/success remains false even when diagnostic controls match.
close_faults: Reported errors perform real CORE::closedir then return EIO. Capacity/read errors must remain primary. Removing explicit closedir leaves one actual retained directory open; removing only the read-error branch ignores a reported EIO after all expected names. Strict independent oracles reject both; observer recovery closes any remaining directory.
fixture: One immediately recorded private same-volume root per case under the existing inert image-custody cases prefix. Exactly declared regular single-link 0400 files with fixed bytes, root 0700. This direct membership helper does not interpret payloads as compiled images. No process, compiler, native query/helper, archive, release or retry.
limits: Finite synchronous direct image-membership controls with actual directory descriptors and modeled read/close errors. No ordinary lexical-cleanup leak, incomplete-image acceptance through the complete reader, asynchronous crash, complete coordinator matrix, native ownership or product activation is established.
observation: Retain actual opendir aliases. Installed Perl 5.34.1 d_dirfd=define supports fileno; duplicate the exact descriptor for fstat identity, close that observer immediately, then inspect original explicit close before recovery. Count actual real non-dot names, never fabricate entries. Read faults return undef/EIO at entry, after one actual member, or after all three.
